headline: Dinamo's 14-goal run meets a NEC without Tadić
summary: Dinamo Zagreb have scored 14 goals in their last 5 games, winning four of them, and Dion Beljo is reported at 12 goals in 13 appearances this season. NEC Nijmegen are winless, with 4 draws, 1 defeat and 10 goals conceded, and Dušan Tadić, their most-used player on 1,082 minutes, is missing in Zagreb. On Sunday NEC created chances worth 3.06 goals against Fortuna Sittard and still drew 2-2. That is why Dinamo are 58.4% favourites, against NEC's 19.8%, rated 0.88 goals the better side, with 3.04 goals expected.
read: Dinamo Zagreb are clear favourites at home: four wins in five, 14 goals in that run and a striker in Dion Beljo who has 12 in 13 this season. NEC have drawn four of their last five, are missing Dušan Tadić, and the market expects an open game with three goals as the fair line.

facts.fact: Dinamo Zagreb are clear favourites at 58.4% to win, against NEC's 19.8%.
facts.meaning: The home side is rated roughly three times more likely to take the three points than the visitors.

facts.fact: Dinamo have won four of their last five matches, scoring 14 goals, and average 2.29 xG per game in that run.
facts.meaning: They arrive in scoring form and create enough chances to trouble any defence at home.

facts.fact: Dušan Tadić is missing for NEC, according to Drimble's reporting from the press conference in Zagreb.
facts.meaning: NEC lose their most-used player this season — 13 appearances, 1,082 minutes and three assists — from the creative core.

facts.fact: Dinamo striker Dion Beljo has reportedly scored 12 goals in 13 appearances this season.
facts.meaning: The home side have a striker in rhythm, the main threat NEC's patched-up defence must handle.

facts.fact: NEC have drawn four and lost one of their last five, conceding 10 goals in the process.
facts.meaning: They are hard to beat but have not turned performances into wins, and they leak goals.

facts.fact: NEC created 3.06 xG against Fortuna Sittard on Sunday and conceded just 0.45 — and still only drew 2-2.
facts.meaning: They generate plenty of chances but are being punished for the few they allow.

facts.fact: Dinamo sit 14th in the Europa League table on 4 points from two games; NEC are 27th on 1 point.
facts.meaning: A home win keeps Dinamo firmly in the knockout places while NEC risk falling well off the pace.

facts.fact: NEC midfielder A. Thomas is suspended for this match, having played 269 minutes across four appearances this season.
facts.meaning: Another midfield option is gone on top of Tadić, thinning the away side in the middle of the pitch.

sources.fact: Dinamo Zagreb are unbeaten so far in the Europa League and want to stay that way against NEC on Thursday.
Dinamo Zagreb have had some difficulties at the start of the season, though they remain a dangerous opponent, according to Vi.
Dinamo Zagreb striker Dion Beljo has reportedly scored 12 goals in 13 appearances so far this season.
Dušan Tadić is missing for the match, per Drimble's live reporting from NEC's press conference and stadium visit.
Assistant coach Haris Medunjanin is leaving NEC by his own decision, Omroep Gelderland report.
NEC need a good result to avoid falling too far behind in their aim of reaching the Europa League knockout stage, with little reward from their first two group matches.
NEC picked up their first point of the Europa League campaign last week against Levski Sofia.
NEC will face a tough trip to Croatia under coach Dick Schreuder, who is hoping to recover from a difficult start in Europe.
